subtitle: Jewellery creation

aboutStephan.aboutStephan1: From the moment I saw gold flowing in a crucible, I felt a deep fascination for precious metals. It became my lifelong passion.
aboutStephan.aboutStephan2: My story began at the Institut d'Art Technique de Bruxelles, where I learned the art of goldsmithing. At KU Leuven, I studied geology and gemology.
aboutStephan.aboutStephan3: My driving force is to bring out the hidden splendor of gemstones in my jewelry. Inspired by great artists, I translate their creations into my own medium: gold.
aboutStephan.aboutStephan4: My travels through Asia and my strong bond with Brazil have influenced my work. I strive to be a bridge-builder between different cultures and eras, where traditional craftsmanship and modern design complement each other.
aboutStephan.aboutStephan5: The process of jewelry creation begins with sketches and designs. In my workshop, I forge with great precision, ensuring my creations are shaped by contemporary techniques and radiate pure beauty.

aboutMaxime.aboutMaxime1: To achieve a revolution in art, you must first reach revolutionary insights within yourself. Thanks to my studies in Fine Arts and the inspiration I found in museums, I was led to become a jewelry designer who breaks traditional codes.
aboutMaxime.aboutMaxime2: This craft has touched my soul and liberated my creativity. I passionately desire to share this passion with you in every piece I create.
aboutMaxime.aboutMaxime3: I owe my expertise to Bernard Biernaux, a highly skilled mentor who forged my talent. At Regnard Designer, integrity, creativity, and a spirit of collaboration guide every aspect of my work. I am committed to delivering high-quality products and tirelessly striving for uniqueness and innovation in my creations.
